title: AT&T breakup testimony before Judge Greene

tellings.quote: AT&T hired me as the final witness

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former presidential adviser, tells Michels he was the closing witness in the government case that broke up the phone giant AT&T, heard in Washington by Judge Harold Greene between 1980 and 1983. In his words, "AT&T hired me as the final witness." He tells it from his own experience, as part of showing how close he was to the top of government and business.
